# Overview of monitoring needs and their implementation {#sec-overview-needs}

@tab-mon-scopes provides an overview over the **priority monitoring needs** identified in phase 1 (@sec-synthesis-1), and their implementation.
This includes specifying 

- the target population, and the
- outcome variables to be assessed to address the monitoring need.

The **target population** concerns either the currently known distribution area in the province of Antwerp (@sec-invasions) or 
In both cases, we consider those parts of the respective area qualifying as potential habitat (@sec-biology).

The **outcome variables** to be measured is either the abundance or local population size, or presence / absence of the species.
Both a trend over time as well as status snapshot in time can be of interest.


::: {.landscape}

```{r tab-mon-scopes}
#| include: true
#| cache: false
#| message: false
#| tbl-cap: Priority monitoring needs and their implementation

# make table monitoring scopes
source("../sample_design/table_mon_scopes.R")

# format-dependent table formatting
is_html <- knitr::is_html_output()
format <- ifelse(is_html, "html", "latex")
booktabs <- ifelse(is_html, FALSE, TRUE)
bootstrap_options <- if (is_html) {c("condensed", "hover") } else {"basic"}
latex_options <- if (is_html) {"basic"} else {c("striped")}

# create table
table_mon_scopes |>
  dplyr::select(c("name", "description", "sample_frame", "outcome")) |>
  knitr::kable(
    x = _,
    format = format,
    booktabs = booktabs,
    linesep = "",
    table.attr = 'data-quarto-disable-processing="true"',
    col.names = c("Monitoring need", "Description", "Target population", "Outcome variable")
  ) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = bootstrap_options,
    latex_options = latex_options,
    font_size = 10,
    position = "left"
  ) |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(
      column = 1:4,
      width =  ifelse(is_html, "100px", "160pt")
    ) 
```
